en: Self-hosted runner: Changed Bash commands to skip the file diff when nothing needs it, so transcripts can lack it; set `bashEditDiffEnabled` to true in managed settings to get every diff
zh: 自托管运行器：变更：Bash 命令在不需要文件 diff 时会跳过生成，因此 transcript 中可能缺少该 diff；在托管设置中将 `bashEditDiffEnabled` 设为 true 可获取所有 diff
